title: He Hears Me When I Call
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
The prophet told the people true
What Heavenly Father said;
The king was cross and shut him in
A yard with walls instead.

[Chorus]
"Call to Me and I will answer,
I hear you where you are;
I'll show you great and wondrous things,"
He says, "I'm never far."

[Verse 2]
He could not go out through the gate,
He could not walk back home;
But right there in between the walls
He was not left alone.

[Chorus]

[Verse 3]
Scout had a question big and bright;
He did not guess and hide.
He asked his Poppa at the meal,
And his mouth fell open wide!

[Chorus]

[Verse 4]
So cup your hands around your mouth
And call one quiet word;
Then fold your arms and tell Him all,
For every word is heard.

[Chorus]
mood: Call-and-answer music. A plain, tender voice calls each line and a soft felt piano answers it back, the way a voice comes back off a high stone wall. Slow, even chords with a little space after every phrase, so the answer has room to land. It starts closed-in and small and opens a little wider with every verse, bright and unhurried by the last chorus, never loud.
